comparisons.finding: Best balance of compact entry and generous expanded editing. At 500px/200%, Ask and Expand require page scrolling; both appear at the bottom. Expanded Cancel/Done remain visible. Component scores: input [8,8,8,8,null,7]; Expand [8,8,8,9,null,7]; Ask [9,8,9,9,null,8]; expanded editor [9,8,8,9,null,8].

Persistent Ask offers the strongest immediate action reachability. However, at 500px/200%, the heading and repeated question labels leave approximately two visible input lines. The tall normal-size field also feels disproportionate to this short question. Component scores: input [7,7,8,8,null,6]; Ask [9,8,9,9,null,8]; header [7,7,8,8,null,7].

Prompts dominate an already populated question. At 500px/200%, neither the input nor Ask appears initially; scrolling restores access. Its expanded editor is as strong as A's, but reaching it requires more scanning and scrolling. Component scores: prompts [6,7,8,7,null,7]; input [7,8,8,8,null,7]; Expand [8,8,8,9,null,7]; Ask [9,8,9,9,null,8]; expanded editor [9,8,8,9,null,8].

Strongest reading sequence: explanation, recorded answers, assumptions, sources. Headings and separators make the complete account discoverable without choosing a control. Enlarged text creates substantial scrolling but remains legible in the supplied endpoints. Component scores: explanation [9,8,8,9,null,8]; answers [8,8,8,8,null,8]; assumptions/sources sections [8,8,8,9,null,8].

The focused reader is spacious, but opening on absent assumptions gives little explanation of the forecast. Other sections and their scope remain hidden inside the selector. Component scores: selector [7,8,8,7,null,7]; reader [7,8,8,7,null,8]. Selector operation and alternative section states are not demonstrated.

Visible disclosure labels provide a better section overview than B. However, the empty-assumption status receives more prominence than the explanation and answers. All three disclosure rows fit at 200%; their expanded reading layouts are unseen. Component scores: assumption status [7,8,8,8,null,8]; disclosure rows [8,8,8,8,null,8].

Best direct view of the portrait and its visual identity. At 200%, text inside the portrait stays small while surrounding text enlarges, and Download requires scrolling. No separate enlarged transcript is shown. Component scores: portrait/orb [9,7,9,8,null,6]; Download [8,8,9,9,null,8]; inclusion note [8,8,8,9,null,8].

Strongest combined composition: visible portrait identity, early Download, and an exact transcript that enlarges. At 200%, Download wraps cleanly to two lines; the full-image route sits below the initial viewport. The thumbnail conveys appearance rather than readable content. Component scores: thumbnail/orb [8,6,9,7,null,6]; Download [9,8,9,9,null,8]; transcript [9,8,8,9,null,8]; full-image route [8,8,8,8,null,8].

Cleanest enlarged reading and full-width Download presentation. However, the initial screen gives no visual preview of the exported portrait; users must open a disclosure to understand its appearance. Component scores: transcript [9,8,8,9,null,8]; Download [9,8,9,9,null,8]; image disclosure [8,8,8,8,null,8]. Expanded preview is not shown.

reason: A gives editing a compact starting point with a useful expanded workspace. A presents evidence in the clearest reading order. B combines sharing identity, readable content and an immediately visible action. Component vectors use hierarchy/typography/surfaces/clarity/feedback/accessibility. Accessibility scores assess visible layout only; feedback remains unscored. These are provisional comparisons, not threshold acceptance.
limitations: Reviewed only supplied images and accompanying descriptions; no source, other reviews or runtime inspection.
Initial and bottom captures establish visible endpoints, not successful navigation, scrolling mechanics, keyboard behavior or focus management.
Prototype draft preservation was reported, but persistence, recovery and production behavior are not established by these captures.
Exports, disclosure operation, selector operation, loading/error states, reduced motion, measured contrast, target dimensions and assistive technology remain unverified.
The portrait is identical across sharing variants; scores concern its presentation, not differences in downloaded output. Synthetic evidence establishes neither provenance nor predictive quality.
No complete functional mean or overall certification is assigned with feedback unestablished. No screen or component is certified to meet the authorized A>=9 and F>=9 threshold.
